instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot. In a minimalist white studio, three friends sit on the floor hugging. On the left, the woman with wavy light brown hair (R3) in a white shirt over a black top smiles warmly. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) in a white high-neck top laughs happily. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair (R1) in a white shirt smiles brightly. They are huddled close, with the woman with wavy light brown hair and the woman with curly brown hair wrapping their arms around the woman with straight dark hair. Bright, soft studio lighting illuminates the scene.
